changelog: 0.11.12 - Fixed the seed tracker dropping banners: when a new gacha rotation starts on the same day the old one ends (like today's update), the new capsules were never fetched because the list was capped at 4. Now every live banner is shown and used by the AI plan.

0.11.11 - The roster has a new filter dropdown: pick any ability (e.g. Crit 100%, Strong vs Red), immunity (e.g. Warp, Wave) or targeted trait (e.g. Red, Aku) to narrow the list to cats that have it. The header now shows the version the roster data actually is, and when the game updates a warning banner appears telling you to hit Detect - which now re-fetches the data for the new version automatically.

0.11.10 - The seed tracker is now a true one-button flow: the separate 'Re-run plan' button is gone, so nothing can double-trigger the AI plan. The single 'Track seed + AI plan' button does everything, and pressing it again cancels any in-flight plan before re-tracking.

0.11.9 - 'Track seed' now also runs the AI plan automatically, so the gacha plan appears right after the tracks instead of needing a second button press (the AI plan button is now a 'Re-run plan' option). The update log in the app now shows all releases including 0.11.6-0.11.8.

0.11.8 - Loadouts are much faster: asking for the same stage with the same roster loads instantly from cache, and stage wiki text is cached too. The abilities panel is fixed (no more fake '2nd/3rd Attack' labels; real 'Multi-Hit (N hits)' with the hit that carries abilities) and now includes Mini-Wave, Behemoth Dodge and Explosion. The roster has a new Immune column, loadout slots show each cat's immunities, and the AI uses those immunities when picking walls and tanks. Scrollbars are back to the native light look.

0.11.7 - Fixed the seed tracker: Platinum/Legend capsules now show the real rarity of each cat (ubers were being shown as Rare/Super), the fake 'Super+'/'Uber+' labels are gone, fest slots show the true cat, names like D'arktanyan render properly, and the two side-by-side lists are labeled Track A (your next rolls) and Track B (the alternate path from a guaranteed 11-pull).

0.11.6 - New automatic seed tracking: roll in the gacha, close BlueStacks, hit Track seed. The app reads your seed straight from the save, pulls the live track from bc.godfat.org and shows what you'll roll next on every active banner (including Platinum and Legend capsules), then asks the AI for a concrete roll plan.
0.11.5 - The app window now brings itself to the front on start so it can't hide behind a fullscreen browser and look blank. The Downloading / Restarting statuses now show animated dots.
